## About
Interstate Fuel Auto Repair is a full-service shop on Main St in Stoneham, locally and family owned and operated. We want customers for life, not just for a one-time service, and we know that means good work at a reasonable price.
Our mechanics are ASE Certified Technicians with the experience and diagnostic equipment to handle all makes and models. We guarantee our auto services. One reviewer said the owner is "very nice and experienced" and that prices are "fair and reasonable."
Stop by, give us a call, or schedule your appointment online. We hold a 4 rating from 41 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Full service auto repair: Repairs and maintenance on your car, from engines and transmissions to brakes, tires and exhausts.
- Mass State Inspection: Don't go without your inspection. Bring your car by the shop and we'll take care of it.
- Oil Change: Routine oil changes at a price one reviewer called fair.
- Computer Diagnostic: We use diagnostic equipment to find out what's going on before we fix it. One reviewer said the owner's diagnostics are accurate.
- Foreign & Domestic: Cars, trucks, SUVs, minivans and hybrid vehicles, domestic and import.

## FAQ
Q: Can you do my state inspection?
A: Yes. We're licensed to do inspections, so stop by or schedule a time with us.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All makes and models of domestic and import cars, trucks, SUVs, minivans and hybrid vehicles.

Q: Can I book an appointment online?
A: Yes. You can schedule online, give us a call, or just stop by the shop.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday to Friday, 08:00 AM to 05:00 PM. Saturday, 08:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
